label: sec:archimedean-hartree-crystal-mass-tower-deeper-preamble
html: The substrate-flow construction rests on specific categorical structures. The Mathlib fillers identify these structures: the Clausen function, the Bloch-Wigner dilogarithm, and the Bloch-group quotient. The subsequent blocks lift the Faddeev-\mathrm{Cl}_2 pentagon identity. They assemble the mass-tower content required for the \alpha_{\mathrm{EM}} derivation.
